summary: The base reproduces the reported exit-127 dynamic-loader failure with an independent ELF fixture. The exact candidate passes its regression and an independent real child-exec test for both supported CUDA wheel layouts, including preservation, deduplication, and restoration of LD_LIBRARY_PATH. No in-contract code counterexample was found, but the original CUDA 13 scheduler/model scenario cannot be run on the assigned ROCm host.

tests.what_was_measured: Base loader failure before Python startup for an ELF with NEEDED libcudart.so.13 and no RPATH/RUNPATH.
Exact candidate regression suite: 3 passed; CUDA 13 venv path injection/restoration plus non-CUDA and mismatched-major boundaries.

tests.command: independent adapter context plus subprocess exec against the ELF fixture
tests.what_was_measured: Child loader success for nvidia/cu13/lib, preservation and restoration of an existing path, no duplicate exact entry, discovery of nvidia/cuda_runtime/lib, and restoration to an absent variable.
Single assigned gfx950 GPU availability and exact arithmetic result [2.0, 5.0, 10.0]; unrelated to CUDA correctness.

gpu_execution.evidence: PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 executed exact tensor arithmetic on AMD Instinct MI350X; rocminfo reports gfx950. This does not exercise CUDA 13.

remaining_counterexamples: A real CUDA 13 environment with torch_memory_saver==0.0.9.post1 and its cu13 preload hook was unavailable, so actual scheduler startup remains unverified.
No Qwen weights were available, so the reported full model-serving command was not run.
A CUDA runtime installed only in the user-site directory outside site.getsitepackages() would not be discovered; that layout is outside the issue's stated venv reproduction.
remaining_limitations: Assigned architecture is AMD gfx950/ROCm 7.2, not NVIDIA CUDA 13.
The prepared interpreter does not contain torch_memory_saver.
No full serving, model semantic, multi-GPU, or multi-node validation was performed.
No native rebuild was needed because the candidate modifies only Python and tests.
